About CALHN
At Central Adelaide (CALHN), we're shaping the future of health through excellence in clinical care, research, and innovation. As South Australia's largest health network, we deliver exceptional, safe and connected healthcare - for our patients, our community, and our people.

With more than 17,000 dedicated employees, every day at CALHN presents an opportunity to make a real impact-not because it's expected, but because our values guide us to be our best. Find out more about CALHN sites and services, our stories and the opportunities to be part of CALHN.

About the Role

Help keep our hospitals safely staffed by providing vital administrative support to the Central Staffing Hub. You'll work closely with the Duty Nurse Manager to coordinate rosters, support casual staffing and keep communication flowing across nursing teams in a fast paced, collaborative environment.

- Manage leave requests by phone and email
- Support casual staff bookings and roster updates
- Liaise with nurses and agencies to fill shifts
- Prepare reports and maintain accurate records
- Build strong relationships across clinical teams

About You

You'll bring excellent organisation, a customer focused approach and the ability to stay calm and accurate in a busy environment while supporting a team that keeps our health services running.

- Deliver high quality customer service every day
- Prioritise tasks and meet deadlines with accuracy
- Use Microsoft Office with confidence and efficiency
- Communicate clearly with people from all backgrounds
- Bring administration or data entry support experience

Why You'll Love It Here - CALHN benefits that matter

Salary packaging - up to $9,010 for living expenses + $2,650 for meals & entertainment + pre-tax super & novated lease options

Safe connections - be part of a culture of safety and connectivity, focusing on outcomes and continuous improvements

Recognition & growth - celebrate success and explore opportunities across CALHN's many sites

Flexible work options - speak to us about flexibility options for this role to suit your lifestyle

Paid leave - with leave loading for rest and recharge

Health & fitness perks - discounted access to Fitness Passport & free flu vaccinations

Wellbeing support - Employee Assistance Program for you & your family

Job Title: Control Room Operator (Engineering Technologist ANZSCO 233914)
Company: Scidell Pty Ltd, an associated entity of Multicom Resources Pty Ltd
Location: St Elmo Site, Julia Creek QLD 4823, Australia
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time

About the company:
Our client Scidell Pty Ltd is a newly formed scientific delivery alliancing company of Multicom Resources Pty Ltd. Scidell is dedicated to providing cost-effective solutions to Multicom Resources, its foundation alliance client, while also seeking opportunities to expand its services.

Multicom Resources is a Queensland-based exploration and minerals refining company focused on discovering and developing world-class mineral deposits. Among its key projects is the Saint Elmo Project, located in the Northwest Minerals Province of Queensland. This project is advancing the production of vanadium and high-purity alumina, essential resources for global technology manufacturers.

About the role:
As a Control Room Operator at Scidell, you will play a vital role in the operations of the Saint Elmo Mine's mineral processing plant. Reporting to the Plant Manager, this position involves monitoring and optimizing plant equipment using advanced HMI systems and automated controls. You’ll be instrumental in ensuring plant safety, efficiency, and compliance with production goals and regulatory standards.
This is a full-time role operating on a rotating roster.

Key Requirements:
-A minimum of 1 year of experience in a similar role, such as a Control Room Operator, or within a related field, such as mining or mineral processing.
-A demonstrated ability to quickly learn and apply knowledge about process plant operations.
-Proficiency in operating and troubleshooting HMI and automated control systems (e.g., DCS, SCADA).
-Strong problem-solving skills to assess process disturbances and implement corrective actions effectively.
-Attention to detail to monitor plant conditions and identify operational changes.
-A commitment to maintaining safety and compliance with health, safety, and environmental standards.

Key Responsibilities:
-Monitor and control plant equipment using modern HMI and automated systems to ensure efficient and safe operations.
-Detect and respond to changes in process conditions and troubleshoot equipment issues.
-Collaborate with field operators and maintenance personnel to resolve process disruptions.
-Coordinate plant start-ups, shutdowns, and emergency operations to minimize downtime.
-Review plant performance data to identify trends and implement process optimizations.
-Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to enhancing plant efficiency.
-Maintain compliance with safety protocols and assist in training new operators.

Why Join Us?
Scidell offers a unique opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge mineral processing projects while working in a supportive and collaborative environment. Be part of a team that values innovation, safety, and excellence in delivering critical minerals to global markets.

How to Apply:
If you're ready to be part of a dynamic team at Scidell Pty Ltd, dedicated to innovation and excellence, we’d love to hear from you! Please submit your application, ensuring you highlight your relevant experience and qualifications.

Scidell Pty Ltd is an equal-opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. While we appreciate every application, please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

result.description: Savic Motorcycles Limited   About the Role   We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer to design, develop, validate and improve the mechanical systems, components and manufacturing processes of the Savic C-Series electric motorcycle platform. This is an engineering role covering the full product lifecycle, from concept design through to production readiness, with genuine ownership of components and systems on a market-leading Australian-designed electric motorcycle.   Key Responsibilities    Design, develop and optimise mechanical components, assemblies and vehicle systems for the Savic C-Series platform and upcoming models, including chassis, suspension, bodywork, mounting systems and structural components.  Translate performance, durability, safety and manufacturing requirements into engineering specifications, drawings, tolerances and technical documentation.  Develop manufacturing-ready designs using Design for Manufacture and Assembly principles, GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis and material selection.  Perform and support engineering analysis including finite element analysis, fatigue analysis and topology optimisation, and develop and execute mechanical test plans and validation procedures.  Support the transition of designs from prototype to repeatable, production-ready manufacture, including release of manufacturing drawings, work instructions and inspection requirements.  Design or support the development of jigs, fixtures, gauges and other production aids to improve quality, safety and repeatability.  Maintain Engineering Change Management records, Bills of Materials, drawing releases and New Product Introduction documentation, including DFMEA, PFMEA and PPAP activities.  Lead FRACAS Meetings focusing on analysis, quality assurance and continuous improvement functions of mechanical components, in alignment with the software, systems and electrical engineering teams.    Support structured root-cause analysis and corrective action processes and maintain fault and corrective action records in Notion or other nominated engineering systems.  Identify opportunities to improve cost, manufacturability, weight and performance of components and assemblies, and evaluate alternative materials and manufacturing methods.  Work closely with Electrical, Software, Systems, Manufacturing, Quality and Aftersales teams to ensure mechanical systems integrate effectively with the wider vehicle platform.    What We're Looking For    Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.  Demonstrated experience designing, developing and validating mechanical components, assemblies or systems in an automotive, motorcycle, EV, manufacturing, aerospace, robotics or related product-development environment.  Strong capability in mechanical design for manufacture, including GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, materials selection, manufacturing drawings and production documentation.  Experience with engineering analysis and validation methods, including FEA, fatigue assessment, physical testing, data acquisition or structured test planning.  Experience applying engineering quality and risk-management methods such as DFMEA, PFMEA, 8D, 5D, DMAIC, DFSS, PPAP or equivalent.  Experience supporting engineering change management, BOM control, drawing release and New Product Introduction processes.  Strong practical understanding of manufacturing processes, tooling, jigs, fixtures, machining, casting, fabrication or assembly methods.  Proficient with CAD, PLM/PDM, project management, engineering documentation and issue-tracking systems; experience with Notion, Jira, Odoo or equivalent systems is highly regarded.    Our Brand   In this role, you will act in accordance with our brand values and help us deliver our brand vision: to make EV riding enjoyable to every rider in the world.   We put people first — our customers are at the heart of what we do.  We design in Australia — being an Aussie brand is in our DNA.  We make informed decisions — using data, insights and experience.  We actually care — each person is personally passionate about what we're doing.      About Company      Savic Motorcycles is redefining the electric motorcycle industry with premium, high-performance machines that blend cutting-edge technology, sleek design and an exclusive brand experience. Our Engineering team is responsible for ensuring Savic motorcycles are safe, reliable, manufacturable, commercially viable, and continuously improving as the business scales. About SideTippers Australia:

SideTippers Australia is a leading Australian manufacturer of premium side tippers and heavy transport equipment, supplying innovative solutions to the mining, agricultural, civil construction and transport industries. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality workmanship, reliable products and exceptional customer service. Due to continued growth, we are seeking a skilled and motivated Welder (First Class) to join our manufacturing team in Chadwick, Western Australia.

Responsibilities:

The Welder (First Class) is responsible for the fabrication, assembly, repair and maintenance of heavy transport equipment and fabricated steel components, ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with engineering specifications, Australian Standards and company quality requirements.

Tasks:

•	Bring equipment, trailers and components into the workshop for fabrication, modification or repair.
•	Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications and cut lists to determine fabrication requirements.
•	Assess fabrication and repair work and plan welding and fabrication projects accurately to ensure efficient production outcomes.
•	Prepare, measure, cut, shape and align metal sections using hand tools, grinders, flame-cutting equipment and fabrication machinery.
•	Perform MIG, TIG and arc welding to manufacture, assemble, repair and modify trailers, heavy transport equipment and structural steel components.
•	Join metal sections using welding, bolting and riveting techniques where required.
•	Inspect completed welds to ensure quality, strength, penetration and compliance with engineering specifications.
•	Finish fabricated products by grinding, cleaning and polishing to achieve a high-quality finish.
•	Operate workshop equipment safely and maintain tools, machinery and equipment in good working order.
•	Work collaboratively with the workshop team to meet production schedules while maintaining a clean, organised and safe work environment.
•	Comply with all workplace health and safety procedures, company policies and quality standards.

Qualifications:

•	Trade qualification as a Welder (First Class), Engineering Tradesperson (Fabrication), or equivalent recognised qualification.
•	Current driver's licence is desirable.

Skills:

•	Proficiency in MIG, TIG and arc welding techniques.
•	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints and technical specifications.
•	Strong fabrication, metalworking and problem-solving skills.
•	High attention to detail with a commitment to producing quality workmanship.
•	Strong organisational skills with the ability to plan and prioritise fabrication tasks effectively.
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
•	Strong commitment to workplace health and safety and safe work practices.

Experience:

•	Minimum 2 years' post-trade experience as a Welder (First Class) or in a similar fabrication role.
•	Experience manufacturing, repairing and modifying heavy machinery, trailers, transport equipment or structural steel.
•	Proven ability to work from engineering drawings and cut lists to produce accurate, high-quality fabrication work.
•	Experience operating workshop fabrication equipment and working in a heavy engineering or manufacturing environment.
•	Demonstrated ability to consistently deliver quality work while meeting production deadlines and company standards.

SALARY: $79,499 to $82,992 PER ANNUM

result.description:
Step Beyond the Workshop with BDGT - Technical Sales Engineer

Are you a trade qualified machinist or engineer ready to take your career in a new direction? If you enjoy solving technical problems and working with customers but still want to stay connected to the machining industry, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for.

For more than 50 years, BDGT has earned a reputation for precision, innovation, and engineering excellence. We partner with clients across the resources, packaging, construction, and manufacturing sectors to design and manufacture specialised components, machinery, and equipment.

Offering complete in house capability across machining, fabrication, assembly, refurbishment, and finishing, BDGT delivers end to end solutions and prides itself on quality workmanship and exceptional customer service.
The Opportunity:

As our Technical Sales Engineer, you'll draw on your engineering and machining background to provide practical solutions for customers and guide projects from concept through to completion. You will work closely with clients, suppliers, and our production teams, you'll become the link between customer requirements and successful project delivery.
Key Responsibilities:

    Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers and key stakeholders
    Respond to technical enquiries and recommend fit for purpose solutions
    Review engineering drawings and specifications to prepare quotations and proposals
    Coordinate material requirements and supplier engagement
    Liaise with production teams to ensure projects remain on track
    Oversee project timelines and delivery milestones
    Provide technical guidance and support throughout the project lifecycle

What We're Looking For:

    Trade qualification in Engineering (Cert III) or a Mechanical Engineering qualification
    Experience working within machining, CNC, or manufacturing environments
    Sound understanding of manufacturing processes and engineering drawings
    Strong communication skills with the ability to build lasting relationships
    A solutions focused approach and strong problem solving capability
    Good commercial acumen and the ability to juggle multiple priorities

Why Join BDGT?

Take the Next Step: Transition your engineering career into a technical and commercial role.

Interesting Projects: Work with customers across a range of industries on complex and rewarding projects.

Great Team Environment: Join an experienced and supportive team that values collaboration and initiative.

Established Business: Become part of a respected company with a long history of success and continued growth.

If you're looking to use your machining expertise in a role that offers variety, responsibility, and long term career development, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and be a part of something exceptional!

For a confidential discussion, contact Lucy Boyle on 03 9116 7465.
To apply for this job go to: https://bdgt.recruitmenthub.com.au/Vacancies & enter ref code: 6909229. Applications close 31 July 2026

BOZMAC PTY LTD, also known as Bozmac Towing Equipment, is looking for a Metal Fabricator to support their operations.

Bozmac is an Australian-owned manufacturer specializing in high-performance towing and recovery equipment, including tilt slide bodies, truck packages, rotators, and towing accessories designed for professional operators across Australia and the South Pacific. Known as the “Tilt Slide Specialists,” the company combines industry experience, innovative engineering, and rigorous testing to deliver durable, reliable, and safe towing solutions built for demanding recovery operations. Based in Hervey Bay, Queensland, Bozmac is recognized for producing functional, heavy-duty equipment backed by quality craftsmanship and a strong reputation within the towing industry. 

To be considered for the role, you need to have a relevant industry qualification or at least 1-2 years' experience in a similar position.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

-Interpret engineering drawings, fabrication plans and technical specifications to determine manufacturing requirements.
-Select, measure, prepare and mark out steel, aluminium and other metal materials for fabrication.
-Cut, shape, bend and form metal sections using hand tools, power tools and fabrication machinery.
-Fabricate structural components, truck bodies, chassis modifications and towing equipment in accordance with engineering specifications.
-Align, fit and assemble fabricated components using precision measuring instruments and fabrication techniques.
-Join metal components using MIG, TIG and other appropriate welding processes, together with bolting and riveting where required.
-Inspect fabricated components and welded assemblies to ensure dimensional accuracy, weld quality and compliance with engineering specifications.
-Grind, finish, clean and prepare fabricated products for painting, assembly and final installation.
-Operate fabrication equipment safely while maintaining a clean and organised work environment.
-Work collaboratively with the team, supervisors and production staff to ensure 
-Manufacturing deadlines and quality standards are achieved.

If you are a motivated Metal Fabricator with a strong commitment to quality workmanship and manufacturing excellence, we encourage you to apply and become part of the Bozmac team.
